valley_E_transition.reading: the transition area is a single-room table. kion confirms Valley E is one room between area A and area B and that the same pattern applies to every stage — consistent with s01e having only 2 room codes in the assignment table.

valley_B.invariants_all_hold: 8 rooms and 7 edges so it is a tree; door count matches the shape letter in every room; adjacency is symmetric; the stored +0x2e/+0x2f coordinates agree with walking the adjacency; +0x28 is the way-back slot in every room; room 0 is the start; exactly one goal; exactly two dead ends; and the single key at A3 balances the single 1-key gate at C3 east.
valley_B.first_verifiable_1key: this is the first layout where a value-1 gate appears alongside an inspectable key placement — A3 holds 1 key and C3's east gate requires 1. Value 1 = one key is now confirmed by balance, not just by analogy with value 2.
valley_B.confirmed_in_game: the in-game map screen shows the player marker on B4 and the corner readout says 'B - 4', matching the reconstruction from the room table exactly. The map UI draws columns A..G and rows 1..5 regardless of how much of it the layout occupies.
